This off-label use implies that Chlordiazepoxide might be considered in the management of Peptic Ulcer Disease, though this relationship is not well-established in the available data. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the pathways are indirect and rely on the association between Mepenzolate and Peptic Ulcer Disease.
